product.name: Aptos Grid Tie Microinverter Solar Panel Kit
product.description: Everything a grid-tie microinverter system needs, in one order. Pick your solar panels and Aptos MAC microinverters, then add the AC trunk cable, the small parts that finish the job, and optional remote monitoring. What You Can Configure: Solar panels Aptos MAC microinverters Aptos AC trunk cable Trunk end caps and unlock tools (optional) Aptos DTU monitoring unit (optional)

product.name: S5! RIB BRACKET 3
product.description: Mount your solar panels and rooftop accessories with ease using the S-5! RibBracket 3™—the durable mounting solution for 1" to 1.125" trapezoidal metal roofs.

product.name: Power Center Bus Cable Tool
product.description: Duracell Power Center Bus Cable Unlocking Tool built for quick, reliable use. Compact design and durable construction for long-lasting performance.

product.name: Customizable BigBattery Home Inverter and Battery Kit for Grid-Tied or Off-Grid Renewable Energy Systems
Victron Quattro 48/10000/140-100/100 120V VE.Bus UL
product.description: Discover the Victron Quattro 48/10000/140-100/100 120V VE.Bus UL at Signature Solar. This versatile inverter charger offers dual AC inputs, true sine wave output, and adaptive charging, perfect for off-grid and grid-connected systems. Available now at Signature Solar.

product.name: Enphase IQ System Controller 3G | Generator Integration
product.description: Integrate your generator with Enphase IQ microinverters for seamless backup power, smart load control, and reliable home energy management.

product.name: Emporia Vue 3 Smart Home Energy Monitor for Tracking Whole Home Energy Use, Monitors 16 Circuits, Real-Time Remote Energy Monitoring, UL Listed
Emporia Vue 3 Smart Home Energy Monitor for Tracking Whole Home Energy Use, Monitors 8 Circuits, Real-Time Remote Energy Monitoring, UL Listed
Cummins Onan Composite Mounting Pad for RS13A, RS17A, RS20A and RS20AC Home Standby Generators
product.description: The Cummins A052A795 is a pre-cast composite mounting pad designed to provide a stable, level foundation for Cummins Quiet Connect RS13A, RS17A, RS20A, and RS20AC home standby generators . Constructed from a blend of high-strength fibers and cement, this 3-inch-thick pad features a 1-inch overhang around the perimeter of the generator for secure placement and comes with all necessary mounting hardware. Cummins backs this concrete pad with a 12-month manufacturer warranty.

product.name: Pytes HV48100 SE High Voltage Battery Module| 51.2V 100Ah 5.12kWh
product.description: Expand your Pytes HV48100 SE energy storage system with a 5.12kWh LiFePO4 battery module designed for scalable commercial and industrial applications.
